retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

score.note: player 1 score, not in the cheat databases: learn it with learn.bat (score=...)

score_p2.note: player 2 score, learn it with learn.bat in a two-player game (score2=...)

p1_input.note: BIOS_P1CURRENT: player 1 stick and buttons, 1 up, 2 down, 4 left, 8 right, 16 A, 32 B, 64 C, 128 D (HD scene)

p2_input.note: BIOS_P2CURRENT: player 2 stick and buttons, same bits (HD scene)

lives.note: player 1 lives in reserve (FinalBurn Neo cheats and MAME 2003-Plus cheats, Infinite Lives PL1)

lives_p2.note: player 2 lives in reserve (FinalBurn Neo cheats, Infinite Lives PL2)

power.note: player 1 weapon power, 0 to 4 (FinalBurn Neo cheats, Always have Maximum Power PL1)

power_p2.note: player 2 weapon power, 0 to 4 (FinalBurn Neo cheats, Always have Maximum Power PL2)

speed.note: player 1 ship speed, 0 to 5 (FinalBurn Neo cheats, Always have Maximum Speed PL1)

speed_p2.note: player 2 ship speed, 0 to 5 (FinalBurn Neo cheats, Always have Maximum Speed PL2)

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over
